profile.summary: Coaching Corps was an Oakland, California nonprofit that recruited and trained volunteer coaches to lead sports in after-school programs for youth in under-resourced communities. In 2022 it merged with Positive Coaching Alliance, a national nonprofit that works to make youth sports positive and accessible for all kids.

review.notes: ProPublica confirms Coaching Corps, Oakland CA, EIN 94-3310845, 501(c)(3) youth development, with filings through FY ending March 2022. Wikipedia supports the volunteer-coach mission and the PCA page confirms the 2022 merger, so the summary is supported and neutral.
